newsitem.title: USA: Peak Tech sees Q3 results below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Peak Tech sees Q3 results below estimates.

text.p: Peak Technologies Group Inc said on Wednesday its operating results for the third quarter ended September 30 would be below analyst estimates, because of weaker sales, order delays and one order cancellation.
The company said its sales for the quarter would be in the range of $57 million to $58 million and its earnings per share would be around break-even.
The First Call mean estimate for the third quarter 1996 was $0.31 per share.

"Results for the third quarter of 1996 will fall short of expectations due to an unexpectedly soft sales month in September following the traditionally slower business activity in July and August, particularly in Peak's European operations," Peak Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Nicholas Toms said.
Toms said September was historically the biggest month of the year for the company and usually represented up to 50 percent of the third quarter equipment and systems sales.

"After an initial strong start to bookings for the month, both in the United States, and in particular, in Europe, we experienced in the second half of the month a number of large high-margin systems order delays and one significant cancellation which have caused the unexpected revenue and earnings shortfall," Toms said.
Peak said it would release final results on October 24.
